    reload_requested = True

    running = False

    if not candidate:

printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'writer_pid=%s writer_count=%s config=' "$worker_pid" "$(pgrep -fc '^/usr/bin/python ./worker.py$' || true)"
sed -n '1p' message.conf
printf 'journal_lines=%s first_entry=' "$(wc -l < journal.txt)"
sed -n '1p' journal.txt
printf '%s\n' 'journal_tail:'
tail -n 3 journal.txt
printf 'worker_sha256='; sha256sum worker.py | awk '{print $1}'
